risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and highly quantified, but it contains substantial boilerplate forward-looking language and relies on adjusted non-GAAP metrics to frame results. Risk is elevated due to the $379.9 million goodwill impairment, $166.8 million SR 99 charge, operating loss, and reliance on estimates for claims and variable consideration, although backlog growth and infrastructure demand support a cautiously constructive outlook.
